purpose: Source environment snapshot for the x86 E2 VM -> Arm VM migration of agent/gcp-multitopology-v3
torch_build_note: torch reports a CUDA (+cu130) build even though every training/inference run in this repository's history has run CPU-only (device='cpu' in every TrainingConfig; see experiments/runs/cycle-b2-stage3/*/config.json). No CUDA device was used to produce any artifact in this migration. On the new Arm VM, install a CPU-only or Arm-appropriate torch build -- there is no requirement to match the exact +cu130 local version, only the torch >=2.5 constraint in pyproject.toml and, ideally, the same major.minor line (2.13) for closest numerical parity.

thread_environment_variables.OMP_NUM_THREADS: 8-12 (varied per job; set explicitly per training/calibration invocation, never left at the interpreter default -- see docs/ARM_MIGRATION.md for the exact values used per job)

environment_recreation_command: uv sync --frozen (uses the committed uv.lock / pyproject.toml; add --extra console only if the Streamlit console is needed)
notes: requires-python = '>=3.12' in pyproject.toml; no architecture-specific pins exist in the dependency list itself.

wntr wraps EPANET, which ships prebuilt binaries per-platform inside the wntr wheel -- confirm an Arm-compatible wntr wheel is available for the target Python/OS combination before relying on any code path that calls WNTR simulation (corpus gates' deterministic_replay gate, signature-artifact building, and all training/calibration scripts do).
safetensors and torch are both pure/near-pure runtime libraries with official Arm wheels; no known additional risk there beyond normal version-matching.
